correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the inverse of the one-row-deleted feature Gramian and the exact symmetric hat kernel. Checked sign preservation for its rank-one correction, derived parity-dependent absolute row formulas, and proved that only the Hamming-1/opposite-corner rows maximize using a central-binomial inequality and a zero-shell complement bound. Sign inputs attain the norm, and unitality gives the exact negativity defect. Independently computed exact Gram-based idempotence for dimensions 2..6, more than a million matrix row entries in dimensions 2..10, and every binomial Hamming orbit through dimension 100. Finite checks corroborate but do not replace the all-dimensional proof.

value.rationale: Removing one observation is a natural robustness perturbation of first-order two-level factorial least squares. The result gives the exact worst-case bounded-data amplification and negativity defect in every dimension, identifies two a priori asymmetric sets of extremal evaluation vertices, and quantifies the counterintuitive positive but exponentially small deletion penalty. These are structural, parameter-uniform properties not obtained from simply evaluating a fixed small matrix.
